electricityContract.variation: Our energy prices are determined by a range of factors, including government rebates, network fees, and wholesale market costs. In response to these changing, we may need to change the amount you are charged for energy. By entering into this Contract, you agree that we may vary the amounts we charge you. You will be notified of any price change in writing at least 5 business days before it comes into effect, or otherwise as required by the relevant energy laws.
